description:
Create and change the workspace's brand kits (editors and admins). The same operations as the brand kit page, so a kit made here looks the same there.

Actions:
- "create": a kit from `url` (reads the site's logos, colors, fonts and icons; company details are researched in the background and land in about a minute), a copy of kit `kit_id`, or blank with clearly marked placeholders. `name` is optional.
- "preview_fill": what `url` would give kit `kit_id`, and which of its sections are still placeholders. Changes nothing.
- "fill": apply it. `replace` lists sections that take the site's version (company, logos, colors (or palette), fonts, icons, reference_images, guidelines); empty means the placeholder sections, so the user's own uploads and edits stay. `add` (logos, reference_images) keeps the kit's items and adds the site's. The reply's `applied` names the sections that changed.
- "update": `changes`, only what is given changes: name, palette {background,text,accent,accent2, notes {role: {name,usage}} (a color's name and how to use it)}, fonts {display,heading,subheading,paragraph,mono} (a family per type-scale role), icons {library?, style?, pinned? {concept: icon name | null}, stroke_width? (0.5-4), color?, secondary_color? (a palette role or hex; null = default), container? {shape: none|circle|rounded|square, fill?, padding? (0-0.45)} | null} (library, style and pinned pick that library's set; the drawing fields keep the set in use), use_icon_set <set id> (use another of the kit's icon sets, an uploaded one too; brand.icons lists sets), company {one_liner,audience,problem,key_features}, overview, tone_of_voice, guidelines {recommendations,restrictions}, add_logo {url | upload_id, kind?: wordmark|icon, for_background?: light|dark|any}, update_logo {id, kind?, for_background?} (a logo labelled wrong), remove_logo_id, primary_logo_id, add_reference_images [url | upload_id | {url or upload_id, title?}] (photos and product shots for the kit's look; a file that can't be stored fails the update), remove_reference_image_ids [id], captions (a caption style object, as a clip's subtitle_settings.subtitlesStyle or get_design_guide brand.captions gives it), voices {language: {code, engine} | null} (a default kit's voices are the workspace's default voices).
  - The brand's other colors: palette.extra [hex or {hex,name,usage}] adds them beside the four roles (a color the kit has takes the name and usage given); palette.remove [hex] takes colors out (one holding a role stays until the role gets another color).
  - The brand's own icons: add_icons {icons: [url | mcp_upload_id | {url or upload_id, name?}], set_id?, set_name?}. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 40 a call: upload_file each file first, then pass its mcp_upload_id (an upload keeps its file name as the icon's name). With set_id they join that uploaded set; without, they make a new set named set_name, which the kit then uses before its icon library. Send add_icons in an update of its own; a file that can't be used fails it and nothing is added. remove_icons {icon_ids, set_id?} and delete_icon_set <set id> take uploaded icons out; uploaded sets are the workspace's, so these change every kit: ask the user first.
- "set_default": make `kit_id` the workspace default.
- "research": redo the company research from the kit's site.
- "dark_logo": make a version of the kit's light-background logo `logo_id` for dark backgrounds and use it. `mode` "white" is the mark in white (instant); "recolor" is an AI redraw that keeps its colors (about 30 seconds, budgeted per workspace). A logo that can't be made white says why: try recolor, or ask the user for a file.
- "delete": delete kit `kit_id`; projects that used it move to the workspace default kit. The last kit can be deleted too: the workspace then has no brand kit, and its projects and new ones are made without one. Ask the user first (saying so for the last kit), and pass `confirmed: true` only after they agree.

Kit ids come from find(type='brand_kits'). get_design_guide({brand_kit_id}) reads a kit in full.

add.description: fill: logos and/or reference_images to add beside the kit's own.

confirmed.description: delete: true only after the user agreed to delete this kit.

kit_id.description: The kit; every action. For create, the kit to copy (optional).

logo_id.description: dark_logo: the kit's light-background logo to make it from.

replace.description: fill: sections that take the site's version; 'palette' is the same as 'colors'.

name: manage_brand_kit
